༄༅/ /nā ro'i chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig nyung ngur byas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nā ro'i chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig nyung ngur byas pa bzhugs so//

khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang shes rab bzang*// ye shes dngos grub bde ba'i rdo rje dang*// bzhad pa rdo rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i dpal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje rgyal po mnyam med rat+na shrī// bsod nams grags dang rdo rje grags pa dang*| |rin chen seng ge grags pa bsod nams zhabs// rdo rje rin chen rdo rje rgyal po dang*// chos kyi rgyal po don grub rgyal po'i mtshan// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ngag dbang rgyal mtshan zhabs// ngag gi dbang po rin chen chos rgyal dang*// ā nan+da zhabs rat+na drag po rtsal// dpal gyi rgya mtsho sngags 'chang mchog grub rgyal// rdo rje 'chang dbang mkhan chen rnam 'joms zhabs// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ma dag las kyi phung khams skye mched rnams// rnam dag dbang bzhis sku bzhi ye shes lngar// rab sbyangs mngon byas sa lam kun rdzogs par// bdag rgyud yongs su smin par byin gyis rlobs// med bzhin las 'khrul bag chags kyis bslad pa// ngar 'dzin lus kyi grong khyer 'dus byas chos// gsal stong yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// zung 'jug bskyed rim rtogs pa mthar phyin shog /sprul pa'i 'khor lor a thung sbar ba'i mes// ra la srog rtsol nyi zla'i rgyu ba kun| |dhū ti sgra gcan khyim du rab bsad nas// 'bar 'dzag bde drod mi rtog mthar phyin shog /chos kyi 'khor lor dwangs ma 'od klong du// rlung sems 'byung bzhi snang mched thob pa'i tshogs// skad cig thim nas tshor drug gis stong pa'i// don gyi 'od gsal mchog la gnas par shog /longs spyod 'khor lor rlung sems rab 'dus shing*// sa bon bsam gtan sbyor bas nying 'khrul kun// rang ngo shes shing sprul bsgyur sgyu mar rtogs| |rtsal 'byong bogs 'don 'khrul ba drung 'byin shog

/bde chen 'khor lor phyi nang rten 'byung gi// dag dang ma dag brtan g.yo ma lus pa// bcos min sgyu mar rtogs shing 'jug ldang gis// don gyi sgyu lus rtogs pa thob gyur cig /'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba rang sems nyid// rig mdangs longs sku rnam par gong 'phel zhing*// gnas skabs rlung sems yig 'bru'i sbyor ba yi// 'pho dang grong 'jug gegs med 'grub par shog /bar do rang ngo shes shing dbang 'byor te// 'od gsal sgyu ma'i 'jug ldang gnas zab mo// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa rtsad bcad nas// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin zhing sogs bgrod gyur cig /ma dag nyon mongs rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros// lha sngags ting 'dzin sbyor bas gnas bsgyur zhing*| |zhugs gnas thim dang 'gros bzhin mthar phyin nas// nyon mongs ma spang lam du lhong bar shog /dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs// rtsa ba yan lag srung mtshams ji snyed pa// nyes pas ma gos tshul bzhin legs bsrungs nas// mchog dman dngos grub bde blag 'grub gyur cig /rang don yan lag bdun ldan chos kyi sku// skad cig mngon thob de yi rang mdangs rtsal// mchog dman bar ma'i snang ngor longs sprul sogs// chu zla lta bus 'gro kun bgrod gyur cig /ces nā ro'i chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshig nyung ngur bgyis pa 'di'ang*/ lcam zhabs drung gi bkas bskul ba'i ngor/ lam 'dis 'gro ba kun sgrol ba 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ shing sprel rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar po'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus dge bar| 'bri chos phyug klung gi pho brang sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas su mgyogs par sbyar ba'o// //sid+dhi rastu//
